title: Chebyshev choice of a good slicing radius (parent Step 2, printed (10))
statement: Let a < b be real, g : ℝ → [0, ∞] measurable with ∫⁻_{(a,b)} g ≤ K (K ∈ [0, ∞]) and N ⊆ ℝ Lebesgue-null. Then there is t ∈ (a, b) with t ∉ N and g(t) ≤ 2K/(b − a).
lean_statement: ∀ (a b : ℝ) (g : ℝ → ℝ≥0∞) (K : ℝ≥0∞) (N : Set ℝ), a < b → Measurable g → ∫⁻ t in Ioo a b, g t ≤ K → volume N = 0 → ∃ t ∈ Ioo a b, t ∉ N ∧ g t ≤ 2 * K / ENNReal.ofReal (b - a)
